# prototype

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use for a requested prototype or unresolved interaction question. Choose the
lowest fidelity that can answer it; existing evidence can make steps unnecessary.
Define the user task, uncertainty, relevant error/empty paths, and what
observation resolves it. Do not make every frontend edit a research project or
recruit participants without authorization.
